topic: A sea reptile with 72 neck bones
script: Plesiosaurs swam with four big flippers, like underwater wings. Some, like Elasmosaurus, had necks around 7 meters long. Elasmosaurus had about 72 bones in its neck. Humans and giraffes have just 7. A 2011 fossil showed plesiosaurs gave birth to live young instead of laying eggs. They were marine reptiles, not dinosaurs.
